name: Crème brûlée
line: Cold, set custard under a sugar shell torched to order. Tap it and listen.
alt: Crème brûlée with a torched sugar crust in an oval tray

name: Chocolate Strawberry Cake
line: Chef Nesar’s signature. Chocolate and strawberry, layered fresh the day you order.

name: Chocolate Kunafa
line: Ghee-roasted kunafa crunch, pistachio mousseline, and a thick layer of dark chocolate ganache.

name: Molten Biscoff Cheesecake
line: Chilled cheesecake that runs when you cut it, Belgian speculoos on a sablé crust.

name: Strawberry Tres Leches
line: Sponge soaked through with three milks, layered with strawberry compote and diplomat cream.

name: TimaMisu
line: Our tiramisu. Espresso-soaked sponge, mascarpone, a hint of caramel, a dusting of cocoa.

name: Summer Mango Gateaux
line: Mango as a 500 g celebration cake. Made after you order, so allow 45 minutes.

name: Blueberry Molten Cheesecake
line: Sablé cookie crust, soft chilled cheesecake, and blueberry compote that breaks through.

name: Rich Malai Bread with nuts
line: Thick bread under fresh malai with grain sugar or crushed nuts. Soft, or caramelised.

name: Ultra Lux Dessert Hamper
line: Four desserts, a box of cookies and chocolates, packed to give.
